fields.friction: per real buy or sell = the sum of the route's fee tiers (pool + each hop; unknown = 1%) + 0.5% (spec FRICTION); no total is stored
fields.hops: route from the pool's other token to USDC by BL-45's hop rule (frozen hops in backtest/costs/tokens.json); native ETH hops like WETH (Q2 A); any other quote token has one unknown hop, 'no hop found by rule' (Q3 A); [] when the other token is USDC
fields.may_differ: true when the pool's fee can change after creation (may differ in Jun-Oct, ASSERTED)
fields.unknown: true = no fee readable: hook-set per swap, a dynamic v4 fee not read (Q1 A), no PoolKey, or unreadable; counts as 1% (spec FRICTION)
